authorization: User November 15 WS2 bounded CPU experiment; no full simulator or promotion
hypothesis: Role/position shrinkage and causal workload continuity improve conditional-minute CRPS versus last-five median with train-only probabilistic dressing
eligibility: NBA points population, positive observed minutes, unique game/player, five verified prior appearances; no imputed DNPs

models.M0: last-five played median; cohort residual variance fitted on training only
models.M1: last-ten mean shrunk with five pseudo-games toward train role/position mean; player and cohort variance shrinkage
models.M2: ridge contextual mean with train-only standardization; causal last-five/ten summaries, trends, role stability, team continuity, calendar rest, home and prior team-game participation gaps; no market

distribution: scaled beta conditional minutes with pregame geometric overtime mixture; fit dispersion on training residuals; compare training beta versus lognormal proper scores before locked test; integer-rounded observation bin probabilities for NLPD
uncertainty: 1000 paired calendar-date cluster bootstraps; game-cluster sensitivity; 97.5% intervals for two challengers
acceptance: At least 1% mean CRPS improvement and upper paired 97.5% CI below zero; MAE <= M0+0.2 minute; coverage no worse by >3pp and within 5pp of nominal; all integrity/conservation tests pass. Historical acceptance does not authorize promotion.
cohorts: changed-role proxy abs(last3mean-last10mean)>=5 or team change
controls: M2 disabled context and deterministic permuted context; future/current outcome mutation; duplicate and timestamp corruption; absent roster never zero
participation_metrics: blocked without complete eligible roster and explicit played/DNP labels; contract fixtures only
rotation_metrics: historical workload-state classification, not authenticated starter classification
rollback: remove isolated WS2 module and research directory; no production imports/configuration
runtime_budget: single CPU fitting, no neural nets/NUTS; 1000 bootstraps; bounded context source sample
